notes: Operator CLI/MCP login may resolve username/password/TOTP from env: or file: refs (or interactive prompts) and may type them into Patent Center only for the operator's own account.
Passwords, OTP codes, and TOTP seeds must never appear in MCP/CLI JSON output, receipts, boards, or git.
Playwright storage_state / session cookies may be stored mode 0600 under the operator state root only; never commit or publish them.
MFA still requires a code (prompt, one-shot code, or local TOTP generation); silent MFA bypass is forbidden.
Sign, pay, and final submission remain natural-person-only and are never automated.

invariants: Unknown and mixed-class bundles fail closed.
Every derivative inherits the most restrictive source classification.
Private bytes, text, embeddings, graph content, identifiers, prompts, caches, and logs remain tenant-isolated.
Private content identifiers are never announced to a public DHT, gateway, or pin service.
External LLM use over private material is denied by default.
Audit decisions contain digests and reason codes, not matched private content.
Only an authorized human or practitioner may make legal judgments, sign, pay, or submit.
